label: 07-认证与App回归
command:
import {pathToFileURL} from "node:url";import {spawn} from "node:child_process";import fs from "node:fs";import os from "node:os";import path from "node:path";
const root=process.env.JOBSIM_PROJECT_ROOT,web=path.join(root,"代码/前端/Web"),{createServer}=await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(web,"node_modules/vite/dist/node/index.js")).href);const work=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),"JobsIM-Group-Regression-"));const vite=await createServer({root:web,configFile:false,publicDir:"Public",cacheDir:path.join(work,"Vite"),server:{host:"127.0.0.1",port:0}});try{await vite.listen();for(const test of ["auth-session.cjs/auth-session.cjs","browser.cjs/browser.cjs"]){const child=spawn(process.execPath,[path.join(root,"测试/前端/Web",test)],{env:{...process.env,JOBSIM_WEB_URL:vite.resolvedUrls.local[0]},stdio:"inherit"});const status=await new Promise(resolve=>child.on("exit",resolve));if(status!==0){process.exitCode=status??1;break}}}finally{await vite.close()}
